# The Lede

> A read-later app for iPhone with a research desk behind it. Save an article from anywhere; The Lede reads the whole piece, unburies what it's actually about, renames it plainly, files it by beat, and writes a short brief: the strongest honest case the piece makes. The user is the editor. The Lede is the research desk.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). No Android or web version.
- The original article is always preserved: every renamed story carries a "RAN AS" line showing the real headline, and the full original text is saved and readable.
- Free tier: 10 briefs every month plus two lifetime "Dig Deeper" investigations, no account required.
- One paid plan, billed through Apple: Membership at $9.99 a month, or $99.99 a year, which works out at $8.33 a month with two months free. Either way the desk reads everything you save, with 150 Dig Deepers a month, and both start with a 7-day free trial.
- Privacy: no account, no name, no password. The user's library lives in their own iCloud, never on the company's servers. Article text is processed transiently to write the brief and never used to train AI models. No ads, no third-party trackers, no data sales.
- Accessibility: designed and tested against WCAG 2.2 AA; works with VoiceOver, Switch Control, Dynamic Type, and Reduce Motion.
- Made by Charles Klein LLC. Support: support@theledeapp.com. Not affiliated with The Lede Company, Lede AI, or the former New York Times blog "The Lede."
